eas_text: A civil authority has issued A LOCAL AREA EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: San Juan, UT; at 4:31 PM on AUG 26, 2025 Effective until 7:01 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Flash Flood Warning for the Deer Creek Burn Scar. Flash Flood Warning for Until 700 PM MDT. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.Excessive rainfall over the burn scar will result in debris flow moving through the La Sal Creek and Twomile Creek Basins. The debris flow can consist of rock mud vegetation and other loose materials. This is a life threatening situation. Heavy rainfall will cause extensive and severe flash flooding of creeks...streams...and ditches in the Deer Creek Burn Scar.
